name: url_shortner
description: This service shortens long urls into short urls
author: Anushil

scripts.typeorm:generate: node -e "const name = process.argv[1];console.log('FileName: ',name); if (!name) { console.error('Please provide a name.'); process.exit(1); } else { require('child_process').execSync('yarn typeorm migration:generate src/infrastructure/_config/postgresDB/migration/'+name, {stdio: 'inherit'}); }"
